title: Incredibly Comfortable Sheets but...
text:
Incredibly Comfortable Sheets but.... This is the first set of bamboo sheets I have owned and I can say, without question, there is a difference.

I tend to get hot when I am sleeping and these sheets stay cool. They are smooth and super comfortable to sleep on, they breathe incredibly well and have become our go to sheets.

While the care instructions were typical and I have never used bleach these sheets have developed areas where the dye has become lighter than in other areas. I can not figure out why this has happened. I have washed them exactly as the care instructions indicated yet the dye has not remained stable which is definitely a disappointment.

I read the care instructions by another reviewer and I can only assume my washing in Tide with added fabric softener was to blame though I’m not sure. I wish this sheet set came with more detailed laundering instructions if specific laundering was required.

While I absolutely love sleeping on these sheets I have been disappointed in the fading / spotting of the dye. If it wasn’t for this factor this set would be a solid 5 star product - and I would purchase another set. Due to the extreme lack of colorfastness or, if necessary, specific laundering instructions, I’m sadly only able to give these 3 stars.
